description: Penguin Teacher Assistant handles foundational tasks, leveraging curriculum standards and teaching methodologies to rapidly generate lesson outlines, lesson plans, courseware, and multimodal teaching resources, thereby freeing up more time for teachers to innovate in the classroom.
